name: Workyard Waterworks U4 Dock v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: L-shaped pond dock: hand-cut planks, fitted piles, braces, selective rope rails
review_note: The Blender family preserves the unmistakable two-tile-wide L with its corner work platform, individually varied hand-cut planks with honest gaps and repaired boards, driven piles with weathered proud bollards and dark waterline bases, below-deck bracing, sagging rope-and-post rails on outer edges only, open shore entry / bank exit / fishing edge, stone-and-threshold contacts at both landings, and the corner pulley frame — at canonical player scale. Deviations: the concept's planking is slightly denser and its shore grass/terrain dressing is Codex terrain work, not part of the asset.
improve: None blocking; keep the 2.0-tile deck and open functional edges when fitting to live terrain.
